messages:
clare-ops: Auditor Ben requested a compact evidence bundle that links the recent RBAC binding change to KMS decrypt activity for the SOC2 reviewers. Wants replayable artifacts + a one-page playback. Can someone take point?

noah: I can own the runbook + manifest. What exact artifacts do we need to include to make it replayable?

"auditor_ben": Short list that will satisfy auditors: 1) infra PR that changed the role binding (link + approver + timestamp), 2) change approval ticket (JIRA), 3) sanitized CloudTrail/Splunk snippets showing kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey against the CMK, 4) KMS key policy JSON + rotation history export (CSV or screenshot), 5) SIEM correlation showing alert -> principal -> key ARN, 6) rollback proof (commands + redacted outputs showing Decrypt success before change and AccessDenied after revert), and 7) a simple mapping table: control ID -> artifact filename -> one-line proof. Keep examples sanitized.

maya: I'll draft the Splunk query and a small playback script to walk through events. Draft Splunk (will redact ARNs/account ids before upload):
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventName IN (Decrypt,GenerateDataKey) requestParameters.keyId=\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777777:key/serve-01\"
| table _time userIdentity.principalId userIdentity.type eventName requestParameters.keyId errorMessage
| sort _time
```

noah: Good. We'll include the KMS key policy export and a short envelope-encryption diagram. Also include where DEKs are cached (serving tier TTL: 180s) so auditors understand replay constraints.

clare-ops: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/589 — changed binding svc-realtime -> kms-decrypt. Approval ticket: JIRA INF-7708, approved by @noah at 2024-11-12T08:54:00Z.

"auditor_ben": For rotation proof a CSV is fine. Please list principals who can rotate (roles or IAM ARNs) and include CMK ARN. Also include a short paragraph on how STS session policies restrict cross-tenant decrypts.

maya: Sanitization script (jq) to redact account numbers and minimize fields (example):
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-11-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-12T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > raw.json
jq 'map({t:.eventTime, principal:(.userIdentity.principalId // .userIdentity.arn) | gsub("[0-9]{12}"; "REDACT"), event:.eventName, key:.requestParameters.keyId | gsub("[:/][0-9]{12}"; ":/REDACT")})' raw.json > sanitized-kms.json
```

noah: We'll also produce a signed manifest.txt (GPG-signed) containing filenames, SHA256 checksums, and a mapping table: CONTROL-ID -> file -> proof statement. Example: CC-RBAC-03 -> artifacts/INF-7708/sanitized-kms.json -> shows svc-realtime principal invoking kms:Decrypt on CMK.

clare-ops: SIEM rule for trace: SIEM-2024-6509. Include alert replay (redacted) and a small CSV mapping alert id -> correlated ticket -> matched event times -> principal.

"auditor_ben": One extra ask: show rollback proof. We expect two short outputs: Decrypt before change (success) and Decrypt after revert (AccessDenied). Screenshots or plaintext logs OK, but please redact account ids. Example test commands are fine.

noah: Example rollback test plan we'll run and capture (redact ids in outputs):
```bash
# generate a test ciphertext (using CMK)
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777777:key/serve-01 --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > test.ct
# before revert (expect success)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777777:key/serve-01 --profile svc-realtime
# perform RBAC revert (remove binding)
# after revert (expect AccessDenied)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777777:key/serve-01 --profile svc-realtime
```

maya: I'll add a small playback.sh that takes sanitized-kms.json and the manifest and prints a step-by-step reconstruction auditors can run locally. That helps reviewers reproduce timeline without live access.

evidence-bot: Upload guidance  use secure bucket s3://compliance-evidence/INF-7708/2024-11-12. Use presigned URLs with 48h TTL. Label files per manifest and include manifest.txt at the root.

clare-ops: Owners: noah (runbook + manifest + PR snapshot), maya (sanitized logs + Splunk + playback script + sanitization), clare-ops (bundle assembly + upload). ETA: draft bundle by Thursday EOB.

"auditor_ben": Thanks  once uploaded please paste presigned link here and we'll schedule a short 20min replay if needed. Ensure no PII/PHI and all ARNs/account ids are redacted.

noah: Will do. I'll open the runbook PR and link it in this thread when ready. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
